notes: All MB figures in documentation are decimal; MiB figures use 1024 squared.
Database includes PostgreSQL/PostGIS catalogs; project relation size includes indexes and TOAST.
Cluster volume includes WAL, all cluster databases and cluster metadata, so it is not the database-only measurement.
Docker images, Docker build cache and Docker daemon data outside the database volume are excluded.
Original CSVs and database storage coexist locally; they are separate copies of summary values, not raster archives.
